# hiloop skills

> Open-source Agent Skills that teach AI agents to operate hiloop — isolated agent sandboxes you can
> snapshot and branch, with tree-native observability. The skills drive hiloop through the `hiloop`
> CLI and follow the open Agent Skills standard, so they work across harnesses.
>
> Status: the `hiloop sandbox` and `hiloop volume` verbs are served. `create --from`, `--volume`,
> `--secret`, and `--capture` are still refused with `unsupported_capability`, and `sandbox ssh`
> needs an endpoint enabled per deployment. `hiloop devbox` was deleted; a devbox is assembled from
> the plain sandbox verbs.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): whole-product orientation — the interface, the always-in-order rules, the canonical end-to-end loop.

## Skills

- [autoresearch](skills/autoresearch/SKILL.md): run a complete metric-driven research loop — propose diverse ideas, execute bounded arms, record evolving idea cards and immutable scored experiments, ensemble winners, and expose a leaderboard; includes a gated sandboxed-arms preview.
- [authenticating](skills/authenticating/SKILL.md): point the CLI at a deployment (the built-in default edge is not live), sign in with hiloop login (default) or HILOOP_API_KEY (headless/CI), whoami, key management; tenants are implied by the credential — there is no tenant command.
- [creating-sandboxes](skills/creating-sandboxes/SKILL.md): the nine-verb `hiloop sandbox` surface — create (positional name, exactly one of --image / --from, --ttl, --storage-class, --port, --volume, --secret, --capture, --metadata, --idempotency-key; blocks until running, no --wait), list/get filters, stop/start/delete, and the retired flags and verbs not to reach for.
- [running-commands-in-a-sandbox](skills/running-commands-in-a-sandbox/SKILL.md): buffered `hiloop sandbox exec` (--timeout 1-3600, output truncation warning, exit codes, idempotency keys), interactive `hiloop sandbox ssh` (stock OpenSSH flags after --, including -L port forwarding), and moving files with volumes, rsync, and files read back through exec.
- [snapshotting-and-forking](skills/snapshotting-and-forking/SKILL.md): `hiloop sandbox snapshot create` (--name, --wait-remote, local vs replicated durability) / list (lineage edges) / delete, and `hiloop sandbox create --from <snapshot>` as the single restore-fork-branch verb; N concurrent creates from one snapshot are the fan-out primitive; disk not memory in v1.
- [managing-volumes](skills/managing-volumes/SKILL.md): `hiloop volume create` (--size-gb quota) / push (content-addressed, deduplicated, never half-published) / list / get / delete, and mounting with `sandbox create --volume <name>:/abs/path` — name resolved client-side, version pinned at admission.
- [assembling-a-personal-devbox](skills/assembling-a-personal-devbox/SKILL.md): keep one sandbox as a long-lived dev environment built from the plain `hiloop sandbox` verbs (`--storage-class durable`, `ssh`, `exec`, `stop`/`start`) — there is no `hiloop devbox` command; getting code in and out over tar/rsync through managed SSH; where state belongs; and the limits that make it unlike a VM.
- [managing-secrets](skills/managing-secrets/SKILL.md): hiloop secret set/list/rotate/revoke + hiloop run --secret (works today); a write-only credential a run uses but never sees; sandbox-side bindings fail closed and the sandbox routes are unserved during the runtime rebuild.
- [launching-as-workloads](skills/launching-as-workloads/SKILL.md): hiloop workloads create/list/show/delete/allow-launch + `--as workload/<name>` on hiloop run (currently the only verb that takes it) — named machine identities with kinded launch ACLs (restrict to users by id and/or service-account keys via allow-launch --user/--service-account); registration is explicit, launching as an unregistered name fails closed (not_found), and delete is owner/admin-only with a confirmation prompt (`--yes` to skip; live sandboxes conflict, past attribution keeps only the raw id).
- [querying-observability-trees](skills/querying-observability-trees/SKILL.md): capture a run with hiloop run (--net-capture modes, --no-otlp, --label), orient with runs list/show/tail/complete (scope a tree with runs list --root-run-id), query with read-only SQL (hiloop query) over the events table + views, root_run_id and lineage_path scoping, runs tail, events payload, run diffs by anti-join.
- [annotating-runs](skills/annotating-runs/SKILL.md): hiloop annotation-schema + hiloop annotations add (a run, an event, a time range, or a project); structured judgments you can filter and aggregate on via ann_<schema> views.
- [reporting-product-bugs](skills/reporting-product-bugs/SKILL.md): hiloop feedback (or POST /v1/feedback) — report a hiloop product bug with expected/actual/repro, evidence ids, severity, fingerprint dedup; product bugs and ideas, never task results.

## Reference

- [fleet dashboard](tools/fleet-dashboard/README.md): public Rich terminal dashboard for runs, lineage, experiment leaderboard, and recent events.
- [events SQL reference](skills/querying-observability-trees/references/events-sql.md): the read-only SQL query surface — the events table columns, query rules, example SELECTs.
